title: Browser game features
description: What the page offers a player, on top of the engine's rules.

entities.name: Play the computer
entities.description: A one-player match against the computer at the level the player chose.
entities.behavior: The player is the left paddle and picks easy, normal or hard, which is remembered in this browser. W/S, the arrow keys, dragging or the mouse move the paddle. P or Esc pauses, and so does leaving the tab. The page asks the server for the match's seed first; without one the match still plays.
entities.outcome: A match against the computer on any computer, phone or tablet.
constraints: No two-player game on one device.
A match the server issued no seed for cannot enter the table.

entities.name: Online match with a friend
entities.description: Two signed-in players, each on their own device, play one match together.
entities.behavior: Opened from the multiplayer page with ?match=ID, the page connects to the games hub's relay for that match and waits for the other player. The first player in the lobby starts it with a seed and a delay that suits both connections. Each browser runs the whole match, sends only its own player's controls a few steps ahead, and steps only once it has both players' controls. Every 120 steps the browsers compare a fingerprint of the match, and end it if they differ.
entities.outcome: Both players see exactly the same match, whatever their connections.
constraints: Cannot be paused: Esc opens a menu while it goes on.
Does not go on the high-score table.
A browser that falls behind makes the other wait.

entities.name: Arcade-style name entry
entities.description: After a one-player match with points, the player may put it on the table.
entities.behavior: The name is typed into underlined slots with a blinking cursor, on the keyboard or on keys drawn on screen. It starts as the name used earlier in this browser session, or else the signed-in player's address before the @. DEL deletes, ENTER sends the match and SKIP leaves it off the table.
entities.outcome: The player's match is replayed by the server and shown in the table with its rank.
constraints: Up to 12 characters: capitals, digits, dots, hyphens and spaces.
The name is shared with every game on icelander.net for the browser session.
No email address is asked for or stored.

entities.name: A match behind the menus
entities.description: The computer plays itself behind the title, help and online screens.
entities.behavior: A silent match between a hard and a normal computer plays behind the menus, and starts again when it ends.
entities.outcome: The title screen shows the game being played.
